articles.headline: How the USMNT is preparing for Bosnia & Herzegovina
articles.description: Sam Borden reports the latest from the USMNT training camp, where players are preparing after several days off.

articles.headline: Japan are more than ready for their World Cup rematch with Brazil
articles.description: Twenty years ago -- almost to the day -- Japan fell 4-1 to a Brazil line-up laden with stars. Now, the Samurai Blue feel like the tables are starting to turn.

articles.headline: FIFA World Cup 2026 stats: Eustáquio equals Pirlo's World Cup record with 5 as Canada make history
articles.description: ESPN's By The Numbers brings you best stats from the World Cup action on June 28.

articles.headline: Brazil manager Ancelotti won't engage in Japan 'mind games'
articles.description: Brazil manager Carlo Ancelotti refused to engage in 'mind games' ahead of the round of 32 clash with Japan on Monday.

articles.headline: Germany face 'uncomfortable opponent' in Paraguay at World Cup, says Julian Nagelsmann
articles.description: Julian Nagelsmann said Paraguay are an "uncomfortable" opponent for Germany in the round of 32 and believes his team will need a "perfect" performance to get through.

articles.headline: Socceroos' phenom Lucas Herrington staying present despite global interest
articles.description: Lucas Herrington, 18, says he's staying locked in on the Socceroos' looming Round of 32 clash with Egypt, and not the reported interest of some of the world's biggest clubs.
